data.title: Industrial Software
data.tagline: Operational platforms that turn machine data into decisions.
data.overview: We build focused operational software where off-the-shelf tools stop short: production portals, quality workflows, asset registers, and integration layers. Every interface is designed for the shift, not for a demo.

problems.title: Spreadsheet operations
problems.description: Critical routines depend on files only one person understands.

problems.title: Integration debt
problems.description: Every new system adds another point-to-point connection and another reconciliation.

problems.title: Software nobody uses
problems.description: Tools are bought for managers but ignore the operator's actual task.

approach.title: Domain modelling
approach.description: Define the real entities, states, and permissions before writing screens.

approach.title: API-first architecture
approach.description: One contract for web, mobile, and machine integration.

approach.title: Operator-centred UX
approach.description: Test with the people who will use it at 3 a.m., not only in a workshop.

approach.title: Boring deployment
approach.description: Observability, backups, and upgrade paths from day one.

capabilities.title: Production portals
capabilities.description: Shift handover, work instructions, and performance in one place.

capabilities.title: Quality workflows
capabilities.description: Deviation capture, CAPA, and supplier quality with clear ownership.

capabilities.title: Asset and maintenance registers
capabilities.description: Criticality, condition, and history connected to operations.

capabilities.title: Integration services
capabilities.description: Secure APIs and event streams between OT and enterprise systems.

benefits.title: One version of the truth
benefits.description: Shared definitions instead of competing spreadsheets.

benefits.title: Faster onboarding
benefits.description: Process knowledge captured in the system, not only in people.

benefits.title: Audit readiness
benefits.description: Traceable actions, approvals, and data lineage.
